items.item_text: resume
cover letter
ServSafe or Good Service Handler Certification (Preferred)
High school diploma or equivalent experience.
Experience in a foodservice operation in public-facing, cultural organization.
Knowledge and/or experience related to using indigenous ingredients in food preparation.
Experience in large volume production.

The Chef supports all aspects of food service operations for the ‘ammatka Kitchen at the Lawrence Hall of Science, which is the home of UC Berkeley’s ‘ottoy Initiative. This position prepares, cooks, and serves both made-to-order and grab-and-go food for the onsite café and other culinary offerings across the UC Berkeley campus. The Chef assists with food preparation, presentation, customer service, catering, point-of-sale transactions, and the cleaning and maintenance of facilities, equipment, and tableware. This role is dedicated to fostering understanding of and respect for Ohlone people and culture through culinary experiences and is committed to creating inclusive work environments for diverse communities.
Food Preparation, Production & Service - 35%
Prepare, cook, and present menu items using a variety of cooking methods, including grilling, frying, baking, and oven production, in accordance with ‘ammatka Kitchen recipes and quality standards.
Assist with menu production, food preparation, portioning, plating, and packaging to ensure consistent quality and presentation.
Monitor food quality, freshness, and inventory levels; replenish products and supplies to meet customer demand.
Support café, catering, and special event operations by preparing food for onsite and campus-wide service.
Sanitation, Food Safety & Kitchen Maintenance - 25%
Maintain compliance with all food safety, sanitation, and health regulations.
Clean and sanitize kitchen equipment, food preparation areas, workstations, utensils, and service areas.
Operate and maintain kitchen equipment, including ovens, grills, fryers, mixers, and steamers.
Ensure proper handling, storage, labeling, and rotation of food products using FIFO and HACCP principles.
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment and promptly report maintenance or safety concerns.
Customer Service & Culinary Operations - 20%
Provide exceptional customer service and maintain a welcoming dining experience for guests and colleagues.
Maintain knowledge of menu offerings, ingredients, allergens, and food preparation methods.
Serve and present food using established portion-control and food-safety standards.
Assist with transporting, delivering, and serving food at multiple campus locations and events.
Be a public-facing voice for the kitchen; event presentations showcasing technique and ingredients used from traditional Ohlone recipes.
Oversees kitchen staff and ensures all food service health, safety, nutritional, recipe, policies, and guidelines are adhered to at all times.
Advising and coordination of staffing needs and schedules. Provides assignments to cooks.
Team Support & Professional Development - 5%
Collaborate effectively with kitchen, café, and catering staff to support daily operations and special events.
Participate in training and professional development opportunities.
Perform other duties as assigned in support of The Lawrence Hall of Science, the ‘ottoy Initiative, and ‘ammatka Kitchen operations.
Verbal and written communication in the English language, active listening, dynamic flexibility, critical thinking, multi-task and time management.
TIPS Training (Preferred)
Intermediate to advanced knowledge of food and production.
Decision-making, reasoning, ability to develop original ideas to solve problems, operations analysis, and quality control analysis.
Basic computer application skills.
Effective interpersonal and work leadership skills to provide guidance to all operational and technical personnel or new employees at this level.
Ability to operate and maintain restaurant food service equipment.
